facts.fact: 在海滩上干了四十多年，身体的损耗是累积起来的
facts.anchor: Working on a beach for over four decades takes a physical toll on the body.

facts.fact: 她大学时因游泳得肩部滑囊炎（关节发炎），此后多年反复发作
facts.anchor: In college I got bursitis—an inflammation of the joint—in my shoulder from swimming.

facts.fact: 2018 年一次常规皮肤科就诊中查出皮肤癌
facts.anchor: In 2018 I went to the dermatologist for a routine visit.

facts.fact: 救生椅的遮阳伞是几十年后才配上的，此前只能自带还被要求收起
facts.anchor: It took us a few decades before we even got umbrellas for our chairs.

facts.fact: 一千名救生员里只有约九十名全职的才有医疗保障
facts.anchor: Only full-time lifeguards—around ninety out of a thousand—are covered.

facts.fact: 有名救生员跳下高椅伤了背，从此再没回来
facts.anchor: I knew one lifeguard who hurt his back jumping off and never returned.

facts.fact: 追上一个海滩抢劫者时追不上，她意识到自己已不如当年快
facts.anchor: When I couldn’t catch up to him, I realized that I wasn’t as fast as I used to be.

facts.fact: 数十年训练后她的海豚式仍在，还能扎到浪底再顶上来
facts.anchor: I’m still able to porpoise to the bottom and push myself back up through the waves like when I was young.
